name: California Urban Tree Canopy 2022
provider: USDA Forest Service Region 5 / CAL FIRE
coverage: 2020 Census-designated urban areas in California; requested extent Santa Barbara CA Urban Area (GEOID 79282), including Goleta
method: Deep Convolutional Neural Network tree canopy classification
credits: USDA Forest Service, CAL FIRE, NOAA; tree canopy by EarthDefine and Dewberry
license: Publicly accessible official data and download; ArcGIS item does not specify a license (licenseInfo=null). Retain source attribution; no unverified public-domain claim.

tile_classes.0: transparent non-canopy or outside mapped urban area

missing_tile_handling: HTTP 404 persisted in .missing.json; samples return 255, never silently zero

comparison.EarthDefine Tree Map: Equivalent 60 cm canopy across contiguous US; full source is commercial, only samples free
comparison.USFS NLCD TCC: Public national 30 m grid, too coarse for roadway canopy intersection

county_download_contents: File geodatabase containing 2018 canopy, 2022 canopy, and canopy change rasters; official CAL FIRE data hub county link.
